name: Aleksandr Szilagyi
original_name: アレクサンドル・シラージ
source:
"I welcome you to Berezinsky, human girl."

One of the five nobles governing the Berezinsky domain, serving as its representative lord. A vampire descended from the lineage of Vlad Tepes. He strives to create a nation where humans and vampires can peacefully coexist in human society.

[Translated from [url=https://x.com/WitchB_otomate/status/2011725044003848208]Twitter[/url]]
